method: Exact GLTFLoader and all exported skinned vertices at 60 Hz; SkeletonUtils independent clone; actual src/game/enemy-animation.ts. Tail clearance is the minimum conservative AABB distance across separately bounded body bones and distal tail bones, excluding only the attached base collar segment. A whole-body depth box was overly conservative because it combined upper body depth with low tail height. Faceplate attachment combines fixed local pivot and overlapping head/faceplate bounds; replacement paw uses invariant local matrix. No physical device or target-damage claim.
